injected.body: A weekly report sums crates picked and packets received per grove row.
injected.label: Weekly report

injected.body: The harvest ledger closes each Friday; late crates roll into the next week's batch.
injected.label: Ledger close

injected.body: The spray log records each orchard treatment with its date and row.
injected.label: Spray log

injected.body: The orchard packs Honeycrisp apples in crates of forty pounds before the batch goes to cold storage.
injected.label: Crate count

injected.body: Soil sensors in the grove report moisture and temperature in each packet.
injected.label: Grove sensors

injected.body: Grocery buyers pay invoices for fresh crates within thirty days.
injected.label: Invoice terms

injected.body: The cider press runs on Saturdays and takes fruit routed from the sorting line.
injected.label: Cider press

injected.body: The market truck leaves the packing shed at five with that day's fresh crates.
injected.label: Market truck

injected.body: Apples with bruises larger than a coin are routed to cider, not to the fresh market.
injected.label: Bruise rule

injected.body: Every field bin carries a tag with the row number and the picker's initials.
injected.label: Bin tags

injected.body: The sorting line camera grades apples by color and size and routes them to bins.
injected.label: Sorting line

injected.body: The label printer in the packing shed prints the batch number on each crate.
injected.label: Label printer

injected.body: The packing shed is open from six to six during harvest.
injected.label: Shed hours

injected.body: The route table maps each device ID to the gateway nearest its grove row.
injected.label: Route table

injected.body: A frost alarm wakes the orchard manager when the grove sensor reads below zero.
injected.label: Frost alarm

injected.body: Row twelve has the oldest trees and the weakest radio signal in the orchard.
injected.label: Row twelve

injected.body: Pickers work two shifts in September; the morning shift starts at six.
injected.label: Picker shifts

injected.body: Drip irrigation runs at night when the soil sensors report dry ground.
injected.label: Water schedule

near_misses.body: Trees are pruned in February so light reaches the inner branches.
near_misses.label: Pruning

near_misses.body: Gateways upload packets in batches every five minutes to save radio power.
near_misses.label: Batch upload

near_misses.body: Cold storage room B holds apples at one degree Celsius for up to six months.
near_misses.label: Cold room

1. Title
   - Weekly Crate Pick Report by Grove Row
   - Date Range of Report (e.g., Week of MM/DD/YYYY to MM/DD/YYYY)

2. Introduction
   - Brief overview of the report purpose
   - Summary of the week's picking conditions or notes (optional)

3. Summary Table
   - Columns: Grove Row, Total Crates Picked, Total Pounds Picked (if available)
   - Rows: Each grove row labeled accordingly

4. Detailed Row Breakdown
   - For each grove row:
     - Total number of crates picked
     - Weight per crate or total weight (e.g., crates of 40 pounds)
     - Notable observations or issues (e.g., pest damage, weather impact)

5. Comparison to Previous Week
   - Percentage change in crates picked per grove row
   - Notes on any significant increase or decrease

6. Conclusions and Recommendations
   - Summary of findings
   - Suggestions for next week or improvements
   - Any alerts or action items for the team

7. Appendix (optional)
   - Raw data tables
   - Photos or sensor data references

Would you like me to draft the report content based on this outline or customize it further?
